verdict.rationale: Databricks documents a built-in assistant, Genie Code, that generates and runs code, debugs and fixes errors, and works directly with Unity Catalog tables, columns, and lineage. Its SQL editor has integrated AI assistance with inline suggestions, and Genie turns natural-language questions into SQL queries and results. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the assistant explains existing SQL, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SQL generation quality against real schemas.
